newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 8.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Prime Minister Alain Juppe calls for increased labour flexibility to allow firms to end work contracts more easily in order to get companies to hire new workers.
-- Former Olivetti chairman Carlo De Benedetti says in an interview that Cerus plans to invest in the French industry and services sector, after selling a 28 percent stake in auto parts maker Valeo.

-- Former Credit Lyonnais subsidiary SDBO to pay a 600-million franc provisional fine for excessive financial support to bankrupt businessman Bernard Tapie. CDR structure selling off Credit Lyonnais assets to appeal court decision.
-- Iran considers buying 10 Airbus aircraft and communications satellites worth 2.5 billion francs, Iran foreign affairs vice-minister said on Friday.
